The 2026 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota is scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of North Dakota from its at-large congressional district. The election will coincide with other elections held on the same date. The primary elections were held on June 9, 2026.[1]

Republican Julie Fedorchak was elected with 69.24% of the vote in 2024 against Democratic–NPL challenger Trygve Hammer. It will be a rematch of the 2024 House of Representatives election.
